name: Startups and non-engineering roles
tagline: Growing overall, but the entry-level share is falling; non-IT sectors are where freshers get in

door_size.caveat: Derived: 4.99 lakh direct jobs self-reported by DPIIT-recognised startups in FY26 times the 36 percent entry-level share of startup hiring; self-reported, includes non-engineering roles, and the entry-level share fell from 41 percent. Non-IT fresher hiring outside startups (hospitality +21%, BPO/ITES +18%, oil and gas +15% in FY26 on Naukri) is not in this number. Trackers disagree on the trend: Naukri shows freshers +15% in August 2026, foundit shows entry-level -9%.

pay_band.note: Inside sales 3 to 5 and ops analyst 3.5 to 5.5 are the common bands; product and engineering roles at funded startups pay 8 to 15 and AI/ML roles 18 to 25 for a very small number. Bank PO and BPO associate roles sit at the low end, and some bank trainee programmes charge a fee before paying.

tiers_realistic.tier1: Yes; funded startups, fintech product roles and IIM-style programme-manager roles recruit from tier-1 campuses. The trap is chasing a founding role or a high-pay startup offer that disappears in a funding downturn.
tiers_realistic.tier2: Yes. Sales engineering, operations, analytics and fintech ops roles hire on a work sample and a conversation, not a brand. The substitute for brand is an Excel or SQL analysis you can walk through, a communication test you pass, and a domain you can talk about (payments, lending, logistics, hospitality).
tiers_realistic.tier3: Yes, and this is the widest door for tier-3 graduates right now: bank PO programmes, BPO and ITES associate walk-ins, insurance and fintech operations, hospitality trainee programmes. Honest caveat: much of it is contract or rotating-shift work at 3 to 4 LPA with a fee-paying training programme in some banks. Treat the first role as a domain entry, and move within 18 months.

entry_requirements: Excel at a working level (lookups, pivots, basic modelling) and, for analytics and ops roles, SQL; these appear on nearly every ops, analyst and fintech-ops posting
Spoken and written English at a level that passes a 10-minute phone screen; sales, customer success, BPO and bank roles test this first
Any-graduate eligibility is common (bank PO, BPO, hospitality, sales), so the engineering degree neither helps nor hurts; what helps is a domain story
For fintech and broking ops: NISM certification (Series V-A for mutual funds, Series VI, VII or VIII depending on the role) is often mandatory before joining

For bank programmes: age under 25 to 28, 60 percent in 10th and graduation, and a clean CIBIL record; some charge a training fee (HDFC Future Bankers 2.0 charges a fee before the salary starts) which you must weigh honestly
For sales engineering at product and industrial companies: ability to demo a product and explain a technical spec to a non-technical buyer; a CRM record of calls or a sales internship is the proof
For founding or joining an early startup: a registered entity or a live product with users; DPIIT recognition or Udyam MSME registration unlocks the schemes

two_year_plan.title: Pick a sector that is actually hiring freshers, and build the two tool skills
learn: Sectors where fresher hiring grew in FY26 on Naukri: hospitality (+21%), BPO and ITES (+18%), oil and gas (+15%), insurance (positive 11 of 12 months); plus banking ops and fintech ops which run standing fresher programmes. Pick one and learn its vocabulary: for banking, KYC, CASA, NPA, cross-sell; for payments, settlement, chargebacks, merchant onboarding; for hospitality, revenue management, occupancy, RevPAR; for logistics, first-mile, SLA, fill rate
Excel to a working level in four weeks: lookups, pivots, conditional logic, a cash-flow model; then SQL basics (joins, group by, window functions) on a public dataset
Communication: one mock phone screen a week, recorded, with a friend or an AI interviewer; the goal is a clear two-minute answer to 'tell me about yourself' and a domain question
Read one fintech or SaaS company's annual report or product documentation end to end; interviews reward this more than a certificate
build: A ten-row spreadsheet of target roles: company, role, sector, tool requirement, fresher-eligible yes or no, application link, date seen; refresh weekly from company career pages and walk-in notices
Version one of the small business or ops analytics project below
evidence: An Excel model and a SQL notebook you can screen-share; a recorded mock screen that a working professional says is passable
At least ten applications a week, tracked; one walk-in attended if BPO or ITES is the sector
target: PhonePe and Groww ops and customer-experience roles

two_year_plan.title: First role, or a founding trial with a scheme behind it
learn: If employed: your sector's operating metrics and the tool stack (CRM such as Salesforce or Zoho CRM, ticketing, payment dashboards); learn the process you run well enough to automate part of it
Sales engineering track: shadow senior sales on ten calls, learn the product's technical spec to demo level, and write the objection-handling document yourself

Founding track: register the entity, apply for DPIIT Startup India recognition and Udyam MSME registration, and learn what they actually give (tax benefits require an inter-ministerial board approval; MSME opens priority-sector lending and government tender relaxations; state startup policies give small seed grants)
For fintech and broking ops: complete the NISM certification your employer or target role names
build: One automation of a routine task in your role using an agent (report generation, lead qualification, ticket triage), documented with before-and-after time saved
Founding track: a live product with paying or actively using customers, and a one-page unit economics sheet
evidence: An offer letter in the chosen sector, or a founding trial with DPIIT or Udyam registration and first customers
A documented automation your manager signed off, or a customer log for the founding trial
target: HDFC Bank branch and ops roles

two_year_plan.title: Move from process to analysis, or from associate to owner of a number
learn: Analytics: Python (pandas) on top of SQL; one dashboard tool (Power BI, Looker Studio or Metabase); statistics for A/B tests and cohort analysis
Ops: process mapping, SLA design, vendor management; the ability to write a one-page problem statement with data is what gets you to team lead
Sales engineering: forecasting, territory planning, and the technical depth to run a proof of concept without engineering support
Founding: fundraising basics only if the unit economics work; otherwise, how to run a profitable small business, which is what most MSMEs are
build: A dashboard or analysis that changed a decision at work, with the decision written down
Version two of the ops analytics project with the real (anonymised) data from your role, if allowed, or a public dataset from your sector
evidence: A promotion, a role change to analyst or team lead, or a documented owned metric (conversion, TAT, retention) with a before-and-after
Founding track: 12 months of accounts and a decision to continue, pivot or close, taken on numbers
target: Product ops and analyst roles at Swiggy, Zomato, PhonePe, Razorpay, Groww
Insurance and fintech operations leadership tracks

two_year_plan.title: Specialise: product ops, revenue ops, analytics, or a second startup role
learn: Choose one of: product operations, revenue operations, business analytics, sales engineering leadership, or a founding-team role at an early startup with your domain

Agent tooling for your function: building and supervising the agents that now do the routine parts of ops and sales (lead scoring, ticket triage, reconciliation), because managing those is the job that remains
If aiming at an MBA later: CAT preparation starts now with two years of work experience, which IIM interviews reward
build: A portfolio of three work artefacts: an analysis, a process you redesigned, an automation you own; each with the business result
A network of ten people in your sector who would take your call, built through real work, not LinkedIn requests
evidence: A role with a title that carries a number (analyst II, product ops lead, sales engineer), or a founding-team role with equity, or a CAT registration with a work-experience story
Pay above the entry band, with the offer letter as the proof
target: Funded startups in fintech, logistics, SaaS
Banks and NBFC analytics and product teams
CAT and the higher_studies path if the MBA route is chosen

evidenced_project_spec.title: Small-business operations analytics: a real shop, clinic or delivery outlet
evidenced_project_spec.scope: Find one real small business near you (a pharmacy, a two-wheeler service centre, a restaurant with delivery, a coaching centre, a kirana with UPI sales) and, with the owner's permission, build them a working operations dashboard and one decision from it. Collect three months of sales, stock and customer data (from bills, UPI statements, delivery-platform exports, or a simple sheet you set up), clean it, and answer three questions the owner cares about: which items or services make the money, where cash is stuck (stock or receivables), and what one change would raise weekly profit. Deliver a dashboard the owner can refresh, a two-page plan, and a follow-up measurement four weeks later. Eight to ten weekends.
evidenced_project_spec.domain: Small-business and MSME operations: retail, food delivery, services; the same skills transfer to bank ops, fintech ops, insurance and hospitality analytics
evidenced_project_spec.agent_use: A coding agent builds the data-cleaning script, the SQL or pandas analysis and the dashboard (Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or Metabase). A research agent finds the sector benchmarks (typical margins, stock turns, delivery commission rates) that you compare against, and drafts the owner's plan in plain language. You do the parts agents cannot: sitting with the owner, understanding what the numbers mean in that shop, choosing the one change, and checking every figure against the actual bills. Keep the agent prompts and outputs in the repository so an interviewer can see what was yours.
evidenced_project_spec.done_looks_like: A refreshed dashboard in use by the owner; a two-page plan with one implemented change; a four-week before-and-after measurement with the profit or cash impact stated honestly, even if it is small or negative; and a 10-slide case you can present in an interview for ops, analyst, sales engineering or fintech ops roles.
evidenced_project_spec.verification: The owner confirms the numbers and the change in a short signed note or a recorded call. Every figure reconciles to source bills or statements. A working analyst or a faculty member reviews the method. The interview test: a 30-minute walk-through in which you can answer 'how do you know that' for every chart and 'what would you do differently' for the change.

ai_task_shift.task_2019: Inside sales: dialling cold lists and qualifying leads by hand
ai_task_shift.now: Agents score and qualify inbound leads, draft outreach and update the CRM; the human call is reserved for qualified prospects
ai_task_shift.human_owns: The conversation that closes, objection handling, and reading a customer's real constraint; sales engineers who can demo and negotiate are more valuable, list-callers less

ai_task_shift.task_2019: Operations associate: reconciling transactions, updating trackers, chasing status by email
ai_task_shift.now: Reconciliation, status chasing and routine reporting are agent workflows in fintech and bank ops
ai_task_shift.human_owns: Exceptions, disputes, vendor and customer escalations, and designing the process the agents run; ops roles are fewer but own more

ai_task_shift.task_2019: Business analyst: writing SQL, building weekly dashboards, formatting decks
ai_task_shift.now: Agents write the SQL and build the dashboard from a question
ai_task_shift.human_owns: Asking the right question, sanity-checking the answer against the business, and persuading a manager to act; this is why domain knowledge now outranks tool skill

ai_task_shift.task_2019: Customer support and BPO voice and chat work
ai_task_shift.now: Chatbots and agent-assist handle the first tier; walk-in drives now ask for judgement roles such as risk investigation and complex-query handling
ai_task_shift.human_owns: Complex, emotional or high-value cases, fraud and risk judgement, and the languages and contexts models handle poorly

ai_task_shift.task_2019: Founder's first hires: a developer to build the MVP and an ops person to run spreadsheets
ai_task_shift.now: A founder with agents ships an MVP and runs ops alone for the first year
ai_task_shift.human_owns: Finding customers, selling, and deciding what to build; a founding team is now sales and domain first, code second

ai_task_shift.task_2019: Hospitality and insurance back-office: manual booking, claims data entry, document checks
ai_task_shift.now: OCR and agents do the data entry and first-level document checks
ai_task_shift.human_owns: Guest and claimant interaction, judgement calls on exceptions, and revenue and yield decisions; these sectors are still adding freshers for the front-line roles

fit_rules.reason: Sales, operations, customer roles and founding are built around people and business, not code or circuits.
Bank PO programmes, BPO walk-ins, fintech ops and sales roles hire in weeks, not exam cycles; the pay is modest but immediate.
Running events and clubs is the closest college experience to operations, sales and founding work.
Ops analytics, fintech ops and business analyst roles are where Excel and SQL skills get freshers hired now.
This path has the fastest time to first salary of all nine; walk-ins and PO programmes start within a month or two.
Founding and funded-startup roles have the highest upside, though most roles here start at 3 to 5 LPA.
Startups fail, contracts end, and BPO and sales roles have high churn; this is not a stable path.
These are Indian domestic roles; abroad comes later, if at all, through an MBA or a global company.
Very little of this path is deep study; it rewards action and conversation.
Non-engineering roles do not use electronics skills; sales engineering at an electronics firm is the one exception.
Entry here is by interview, work sample and phone screen, not by exam; exam strength does not transfer.
This is the widest door for tier-3 graduates: any-graduate eligibility, walk-ins, and programmes that hire on communication and a work sample.
Fintech and startup ops are concentrated in Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune, Mumbai and NCR; bank and BPO roles are everywhere.
Bank branches, insurance, BPO centres in tier-2 cities and founding a local business all work near home; startup product roles do not.
An internship is the strongest signal for ops, sales and analyst roles, which hire on demonstrated work.
You can start here with four weeks of Excel and communication practice; no long preparation is required, but the pay reflects that.
Walk-ins, PO programmes and off-campus drives are open now and favour candidates who can join immediately.
Any-graduate roles do not care about branch; a non-core branch loses nothing here.
